calendar.matters:
AMENDED ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-10-2012 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Change of Name of TWO minorS.
Dept. 514, Judge: Donald Sullivan, Clerk: S. Ravinantapricha, CSR: Sonia Wong, #11288
Petitioner hELEN hUNGKIN TAM (mother) was present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem for the minors Vincent Keith Gallop and Richard Bruce Gallop and with Cantonese Interpreter: William Guan. Petitioner and Interpreter was placed under oath and examined.

Proof of Death of minors' father John Sparks by Chief Medical Examiner Amy P. Hart, MD. dated 02-21-12 was submitted for review in open court.

Proof of Publication is in the file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of the Minors to Vincent Keith Tam and Richard Bruce Tam.
Decree Changing Name was submitted to and signed by the Court.
